tool.name: LAMMPS (Frontier)
tool.command:
. /etc/profile && module load PrgEnv-cray && module load craype-accel-amd-gfx90a && module load cray-fftw && module load cpe && module load rocm &&
mkdir -p lammps_outputs &&
ln -s $lmp input.lmp && ln -s $xyz input.xyz &&
sed -i 's|\S*\.xyz|../input.xyz|g' input.lmp &&
export INSTDIR="/lustre/orion/bip280/proj-shared/LAMMPS_Stable_KOKKOSwfcut/lammps/install/bin" && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 && export MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1 &&
( cd lammps_outputs && \${INSTDIR}/lmp_frontier -k on g 1 -sf kk -pk kokkos -in ../input.lmp ) > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)
tool.help:
**LAMMPS (Frontier)**
This is a Galaxy tool to run LAMMPS on Frontier.
